title: Volcanoes of Guatemala (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Guatemala, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Chicabal
rounds.fact: Chicabal is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 2,720 m in the source data. The data places it in Guatemala.

rounds.name: Santa Maria
rounds.fact: Santa Maria is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1990. The data places it in Guatemala.
